brief.data: Grant NRI-KE-2025-118 is funded by the Halvorsen Foundation: 'Turkana WASH Resilience', $1,840,000, running Apr 2025 to Mar 2027. It has 9 budget lines; for example, Line 4 'Community Hygiene Training' has a budget of $212,000 and $61,400 spent, and Line 6 'Borehole Rehabilitation' has $540,000 budgeted and $512,900 spent. Proposed move: $85,000 from Line 4 to Line 6, which is 40.1% of Line 4. Donor rule: moves over 10% of any line need prior written approval from the donor. Internal approvals needed: Grants Manager (Peter Owino), then Regional Finance Controller (Lucía Ferrer). Her onboarding plan has 7 required steps, of which 2 are done (system access and policy acknowledgment). There are 34 glossary terms and 112 help articles, including 'Reallocation vs. Amendment' and 'Halvorsen Foundation donor rules summary'. Helpdesk queue 'Grants-Systems' has a typical response time of 4 business hours. Her last 3 actions were: opened the grant record, viewed the budget lines, and started a draft request.

prompt:
I need the front end for Ledgerline. An in-house grants-management system built by a large international humanitarian NGO's IT team for its grants and compliance department to track donor awards, budgets and reporting obligations.

Who's using it: Aisha Kamau, who just moved from four years as a field program manager to a grants officer post at Northbridge Relief International's Nairobi regional office. She knows the programs well but has never used Ledgerline or handled donor compliance.

What they're doing right now: It's her third day. Her supervisor has asked her to prepare her first budget reallocation request on an active water-and-sanitation grant. The request moves funds from an underspent training line to borehole rehabilitation. She is learning the system by doing this one real task. She doesn't know what 'variance threshold', 'donor prior approval' or 'cost category lock' mean here. She also doesn't know which reallocations need donor sign-off, or who in the department has to approve. She wants help that explains things right when they come up, a sense of where she is in the department's required steps, and a way to reach the internal grants helpdesk if she gets stuck.

What's in the system at this point: Grant NRI-KE-2025-118 is funded by the Halvorsen Foundation: 'Turkana WASH Resilience', $1,840,000, running Apr 2025 to Mar 2027. It has 9 budget lines; for example, Line 4 'Community Hygiene Training' has a budget of $212,000 and $61,400 spent, and Line 6 'Borehole Rehabilitation' has $540,000 budgeted and $512,900 spent. Proposed move: $85,000 from Line 4 to Line 6, which is 40.1% of Line 4. Donor rule: moves over 10% of any line need prior written approval from the donor. Internal approvals needed: Grants Manager (Peter Owino), then Regional Finance Controller (Lucía Ferrer). Her onboarding plan has 7 required steps, of which 2 are done (system access and policy acknowledgment). There are 34 glossary terms and 112 help articles, including 'Reallocation vs. Amendment' and 'Halvorsen Foundation donor rules summary'. Helpdesk queue 'Grants-Systems' has a typical response time of 4 business hours. Her last 3 actions were: opened the grant record, viewed the budget lines, and started a draft request.

Build it as a working web app, opened in the state that person would see at that moment. No backend: use realistic mock data (no lorem ipsum, no placeholder names), and make the interactive parts actually work client-side.

Use whatever framework and tooling you like. When you're done there must be a static production build in ./out with ./out/index.html as the entry point. It will be served from the root of a plain static file server (no rewrites, no server code) and viewed in a desktop browser at 1440×900.
